Welcome To Yucca Veterinary Medical Center
Yucca Veterinary Medical Center
in Belen, NM, provides trusted veterinary care for pets and livestock. We are dedicated to treating every animal like a valued member of the family.
Book Appointment
About Yucca Veterinary Medical Center
At
Yucca Veterinary Medical Center
, we provide compassionate, high-quality veterinary care for pets and large animals in Belen, NM, and the surrounding Valencia County communities. As a locally owned, full-service hospital, we offer comprehensive medicine and surgery for dogs, cats, horses, cattle, and other livestock, with a strong focus on preventive care, client education, and low-stress handling.
More About Us
A Facility Built for Comfort and Care
Every detail of our hospital was designed with your animal’s comfort and safety in mind. Our spacious, modern facility is equipped with advanced diagnostic tools, dedicated surgical suites, and separate areas for large and small animals. Whether you visit us for a wellness exam, a complex surgery, or herd health management, you can expect a clean, organized, and welcoming environment for both you and your animals.
Contact Us
Veterinary Services in Belen and Beyond
We proudly serve animals and their families across Belen, Los Lunas, Bosque Farms, Peralta, Valencia County, and nearby rural communities.

Our skilled and dedicated
veterinary team
is committed to providing individualized, compassionate care. From your first visit, you’ll experience our friendly, down-to-earth approach, where every question is welcomed, and every decision is made with your animal’s best interests in mind. We believe in building lasting relationships based on trust, empathy, and exceptional medicine.
